error: ValueError: Mask must have boolean scalar type (Triton tl.store)
root_cause: valid is loaded from GM uint8 tensor, type is int8 not bool. Bitwise & with boolean expressions results in int8, not bool. Triton tl.store mask requires bool type.
fix: Changed valid to (valid != 0) for explicit bool conversion. Combined with previous broadcast fix (writable & (latent_col >= 0)) for vector shape.
warning_also_seen: tl.where with a non-boolean condition is deprecated, Got int8 (same root cause)
note: native_writer.py Triton kernel should use (valid != 0) not raw valid for boolean expressions. Also consider explicit tl.cast(valid, tl.int1) if needed.
